titulo.estudio: Un courriel de confirmation : Observer les formes
titulo.alumno: A confirmation email: vocabulary and forms

intro: Identify the reason for the email, the date and the action the recipient must take. Read the French first; open the translation when you want to check your understanding.

frases.estudio: Le paiement se fera à l'arrivée; le petit déjeuner n'est pas compris.
frases.alumno: Payment will be made on arrival; breakfast is not included.

frases.estudio: Vous trouverez le plan de l'hôtel en pièce jointe. Merci de répondre avant lundi.
frases.alumno: You will find the hotel plan attached. Please reply before Monday.

texto: Identify the reason for the email, the date and the action the recipient must take. Link the subject with the request and check the dates, conditions and actions the message asks you to carry out.
Point to note: in emails, the subject line, greeting and closing formula guide the reading; pronouns replace information already mentioned. In this passage, «pièce jointe» means «attachment».
